title: ID0401044-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117078] Meter Start is 0
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
We have received the following feedback from one of our customers regarding a device, and we kindly request your analysis:
"The device is not providing sufficient stop or start values, and during many operations, the meter start value is shown as 0 kWh. What could be the reason for this?"
Could you please investigate this issue and provide your
insights?
Root cause: NO LEM Meter address
Solution: LEM Meter address added
